failure_modes: Adaptive discovery reuse and the near tie among top means may fail to reproduce in fresh independent batches; no causal affinity benefit or validated optimal parameter is established.

Fixed-world-frame Hungarian matching is sensitive to pose, teacher choice and assignment changes; sparse teacher support and observational scores can bias the mixture. No distinct conformational modes are certified.

Coordinate reward progress can coexist with poor final affinity, invalid attempts, receptor clashes or high strain tails. Backtracking constraints are safeguards, not proof of physical quality; no demonstrated chemical-graph mechanism is supplied.
Regional associations may duplicate global translation/shape and overlap spatially; node sign reversals and failed fitted-curve fidelity preclude a fixed or extrapolated regional direction.
Parent-child forecast increments and survival enrichment do not establish beneficial physical motion or future affinity credit; ancestors, descendants and repeated nodes are not independent batches.

The supplied discovery summaries omit complete affinity failure accounting, paired uncertainty, raw baseline physical tails and a material strain margin. Retention is a testable candidate choice, not a claim that the task objective has already been achieved.
